featured_reviews.name: Yogita Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the oldest sweet shops in Mumbai since 1947. Its very first branch opened near J. J. Hospital in Mumbai & now it is in Vasai ! 🤩

They are very famous for their Mawa Jalebi, Malpua, Matka Rabri & a lot more tasty delicacies.

We tried a lot of stuff here and everything tasted absolutely delicious!! 🤤 Matka rabri had very thick rabri which tasted very yummyyy. Truly their jalebi & malpua tastes very very good !

Something really good about this place is that they have seperate arrangements for cooking veg (eggless sweets) & non veg (sweets that contain egg). Also, their staff is really very kind. You gotta definitely try this place ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the oldest sweet shops in Vasai serving sweets with an authentic taste and quality. A great variety to choose from for every special occasion.

We tried -
Malai Rabdi
Mawa Jalebi with rabdi
Malpua with Rabdi
Firni
Mawa Khaja
Mawa Cake

Gulab Jamun
Dry fruit Halwa
Milk cake
Balu shahi
Mawa khaja
Aflatoon

Nankhatai

Mawa cake

Each of the above items were delectable in their own way. Freshly prepared and melt-in-mouth sweets, that are perfect for every special occasion.
We loved how the sweets were not too sugary or extra sweet. The flavours were perfect and right amount of sweet.

Hygiene maintained well. Courteous staff who'll help you choose from a variety of sweets.
Would definitely visit again everytime I visit Vasai!

featured_reviews.name: Charitra Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
This has been my first experience with Sweet Home Bakery by Zoya Mulla and I’m sure there’s going to be more. I’m not the one who usually shops blindly just for sake of filling in the need. People who know me would know that I always do my thorough research before I buy something even if it’s minimal. I had seen a few of my friends post about her cake reviews and had even checked online, the least I could say is I had already shortlisted this place for the right time. It was for my bday that I hadn’t planned anything for but had to push in last minute as my close friends and cousins decided to not let go. So I knew I had to get a really good quality cake within a day. I called up Zoya to ask if whether she could get me a cake ready in a short notice (called up at around 9pm to get a cake ready by next day 6pm), it was my very first interaction with her. I honestly had backup plans like going to the town to a gourmet cake store and buying a cake cause usually the homebakers don’t entertain orders in such a short notice. My first impression about Zoya was that she was very kind, flexible and accomplished. She agreed. I didn’t have much demands though. Asked her to keep it simple and in whatever flavour was available due to sourcing of the ingredients. She sent me a list of available flavours and I chose Nutella Hazelnut 1kg cake.  No too many calls messages or bothering. Very professionally she took up the task and completed on time. My cake was ready the next day by 6pm as promised.
THE MAIN PART- My guests LOVED the cake !! They were indulgent as I could see. The quality of the products used were rich as one could easily tell. Though I ordered for a 1kg cake it was definitely 1.5 so the quantity was good enough too. The rich chocolate plus the crunch of fresh good quality hazelnuts were a hit. I’m just very happy and impressed with my overall experience. It’s a double thumbs up from me 👍🏼👍🏼

featured_reviews.name: Nilofer Lemos
featured_reviews.review_text: You can trust Zoya@Sweet Home Bakery 💓 with any flavor. I leave it upto her this time for her own design, and I knew it will be bang on. Simple design, big flavor, beautiful cake 🤗

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shri Aai Ashram may have its beginnings at Om Nagar, but this Vasai West branch near Sai Mandir has carved its own niche in my heart. Memories of school mornings fueled by their golden, crispy samosas still spark joy, and this New Year's sweet shopping trip just cemented their place as a Vasai favorite.

Walking into Shri Aai Ashram is like stepping into a wonderland of sugary delights. The variety is truly mind-blowing! From traditional Indian mithai like pedas and barfis to modern innovations like chocolate-stuffed gulab jamuns, they have something to tantalize every taste bud. I was particularly impressed by their selection of sugar-free options, a thoughtful touch for health-conscious sweet lovers.

It's not just the sweets that make Shri Aai Ashram special. The friendly owner and staff radiate genuine warmth, making every visit a pleasure. They're always happy to offer recommendations and answer questions, creating a welcoming atmosphere that extends beyond the counter.

Whether you're a local with childhood memories like me or a curious newcomer, Shri Aai Ashram is a must-visit. It's not just a sweet shop, it's a testament to Vasai's love affair with delectable treats and warm hospitDon't miss out on this Vasai gem. Shri Aai Ashram will satisfy your sweet tooth and leave you with a smile, just like it did for me.

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan in Vasai and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed! This is the oldest sweet mart in Vasai and has been serving delicious treats for decades. It's no wonder why all the local schools, colleges, and offices order their samosas from here.

As soon as I walked in, I was hit with a wave of nostalgia. The old-school charm of the place instantly transported me back to simpler times. What made it even better was the fact that the staff was the same as it was 15 years ago! It's truly heartwarming to see the same smiling faces behind the counter, still dedicated to serving their customers with the same passion.

But let's talk about the food. The samosas were out of this world. Perfectly crispy on the outside and filled with the most delicious mixture of spiced potatoes on the inside. It's no wonder why this place has such a loyal following.

And if you're not in the mood for samosas, don't worry. Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan offers a wide variety of mouth-watering treats that will satisfy any craving. From sweets to savory snacks, everything is made fresh daily and with the utmost care.

Overall, I highly recommend Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan to anyone in Vasai or the surrounding area. The nostalgic atmosphere combined with the delicious food and friendly staff make this place a must-visit. Don't miss out on this gem of a sweet mart!
